caption: Figure 1 : SAM 3 improves over SAM 2 on promptable visual segmentation with clicks (left) and introduces the new promptable concept segmentation capability (right). Users can segment all instances of a visual concept specified by a short noun phrase, image exemplars (positive or negative), or a combination of both.
